name: mirage
text: You're right, and I'm sorry. I said I was doing them, then answered your newer questions first and never started the items. Since your last message: BK1c is under way and the first real fix is in. The matcher would treat 'Virginia' as the same team as 'West Virginia'; that's fixed and tested (tests pass) and saved to the repo. I'm continuing with the rest of the matching audit, then BK1b, then BK2, without stopping to write them down. Next message from me will be a result.
